used_receipt.sql: INSERT INTO procurement.commercial_command_receipts(id,purchase_order_id,operation,command_key,actor_principal_id,fingerprint,response_json,completed_at,tenant_id,legal_entity_id,created_at,created_by,version) SELECT '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222201',id,'InvoiceMapping','22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222202','SYNTHETIC-NEGATIVE',repeat('a',64),'{"syntheticRollbackNegative":true}',now(),tenant_id,legal_entity_id,now(),'SYNTHETIC-NEGATIVE',1 FROM procurement.purchase_orders ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;

audit_only.sql: INSERT INTO procurement.audit_events SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::procurement.audit_events,to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object('id','22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222203','record_type','SourcingPolicyIdentityEvidence','action','create','changed_fields_json',jsonb_build_object('syntheticRollbackNegative',true)))).* FROM procurement.audit_events a ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;

outbox_only.sql: INSERT INTO procurement.outbox_events(id,event_type,event_version,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,payload_json,idempotency_key,state,attempts,tenant_id,legal_entity_id,created_at,created_by,version) SELECT '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222204','purchase_request.approval_opened.v1',1,'PurchaseRequest','22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222205','{"syntheticRollbackNegative":true}','SYNTHETIC-CANONICAL-DOWN-NEGATIVE','Pending',0,tenant_id,legal_entity_id,now(),'SYNTHETIC-NEGATIVE',1 FROM procurement.suppliers ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;

allocation_precision.sql: INSERT INTO procurement.purchase_request_allocations(id,purchase_request_id,purchase_request_line_id,method,status,quantity,estimated_value,currency_code,reason,tenant_id,legal_entity_id,created_at,created_by,version) SELECT '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222206',purchase_request_id,id,'SyntheticLegacy','Released',1,0.00000001,'ZMW','SYNTHETIC precision negative, not demand authority',tenant_id,legal_entity_id,now(),'SYNTHETIC-NEGATIVE',1 FROM procurement.purchase_request_lines ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;

partial_checker.sql: INSERT INTO procurement.audit_events(id,record_type,record_id,action,actor_subject_id,changed_fields_json,tenant_id,legal_entity_id,created_at,created_by,version) SELECT '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222207','PurchaseRequest','22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222208','BudgetChecked','SYNTHETIC-NEGATIVE',jsonb_build_object('CheckedByWorkerId','22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222209','syntheticRollbackNegative',true),tenant_id,legal_entity_id,now(),'SYNTHETIC-NEGATIVE',1 FROM procurement.suppliers ORDER BY id LIMIT 1;
